title: Press Post Independence
definition: The evolution of the Indian press from a tool of anti-colonial struggle to a 'Fourth Estate' in a democratic republic, governed by constitutional provisions and statutory regulations.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the evolution of democratic institutions, freedom of speech (Article 19), and the tension between state security and media autonomy.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Press Post Independence.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: History of Press during British Rule (Vernacular Press Act, etc.)
